memory_candidates.content: On the current Lean/Mathlib pin, the omega tactic introduces Classical.choice into a declaration's #print axioms record; when a probe advertises a choice-free half, replace omega on Nat index goals with explicit lemmas (Nat.one_pos, Nat.le_add_left, Nat.succ.inj, Nat.succ_ne_zero, Nat.succ_le_succ, Nat.succ_pos).

Evidence probes under specs/evidence/ compile in about 3 seconds via 'lake env lean' (outside the Lake build graph), so a research dispatch can prototype-compile a whole probe in the scratchpad instead of relying on LSP lookups; the gate script's check_probe only runs lake env lean and does not scan for sorry.
